initialAutoHideInference: withdrawn; true calls are scroll/gesture interactions, renderReader preserves state
continuousAppend: next chapter images appended; page/seek/persistence remain chapter local; identity resolves later directories
prefetchThreshold: firstVisibleItem + visibleItemCount >= totalItemCount - 5; total includes the footer
fixedCanvas: setReaderFullscreen resets content transforms and only animates chrome
excerptFormat: Annotated Git source lines; blank line prefix padding omitted for whitespace check. Original annotation retained in ZIP. The frozen Java blob is unchanged.
